Kidnapper above described, accosted complainant
who was riding in his private rickshaw north to south
on Moulmein Road, pulled him out of the vehicle and
attempted to force him into a hire car which was park-
ed at this spot. Complainant struggled and his ricksha
coolie raised an alarm, which caused the kidnappers
to drive away in their car. Complainant escaped.

pages.en:
At 9 a.m. 21-8-40, S.P.C. 634 brought to the
station complainant in this case and the latter's
private ricksha coolie. Complainant stated that an
attempt had been made to kidnap him on Moulmein Road
near Avenue Foch, but that the kidnappers had been
unsuccessful on account of the struggle put up by
him and the alarm raised by his ricksha coolie.
Inquiries regarding the case were made by the
undersigned and C.D.S. 174 who ascertained the follow-
ing particulars.
Complainant Koeng Sien Fung resides at House 6,
Lane 75 Moulmein Road and is employed as cashier by
the Manufacturer's Bank of China branch office at
512 Avenue Joffre. Although in comfortable circum-
stances, complainant is not a wealthy man. Follow-
ing his daily custom, he left home at 8.45 a.m.
21-8-40 to proceed to the bank and travelled in his
private ricksha, S.M.C. Licence No. 1438 pulled by
one Kiang Ling Fah (江林發), badge No. 6817. When
the ricksha had passed the Kwang Hua (光華) Middle
School on Moulmein Road, a male Chinese (full des-
cription given on Sheet 1) darted out from the foot-
path and caught hold of complainant causing him to
fall out of the ricksha. The kidnapper then attempted
to force the complainant into a closed motor car
which was parked on the east side of Moulmein Road
about twenty yards south of the Kwang Hua Middle
School. Complainant resisted the kidnapper's efforts
to force him into the car, and attempted to run away,
both men at the time struggling on the roadway.
pages.zh:
40年8月21日上午9时，警员634号将本案投诉人及其私人黄包车夫带至巡捕房。投诉人称，有人在福煦路附近的莫利爱路上试图绑架他，但因其本人挣扎以及黄包车夫呼救，绑匪未能得逞。
下述签署人与刑事侦缉警员174号对此案进行了查询，并查明了以下详情。
投诉人孔憲章居住于莫利爱路75弄6号，受雇于霞飞路512号中国制造商银行分行，担任出纳员。虽然生活宽裕，但投诉人并非富豪。按照日常习惯，他于40年8月21日上午8时45分离家前往银行，乘坐其私人黄包车，车牌号为公共租界1438号，车夫为江林發 (Kiang Ling Fah)，徽章号6817。当黄包车经过莫利爱路上的光華中学时，一名华籍男子（详细描述见第1页）从人行道上冲出，抓住投诉人，致使其从黄包车上跌落。随后，该绑匪试图将投诉人强行塞进一辆停在莫利爱路东侧、光華中学以南约二十码处的封闭轿车内。投诉人反抗绑匪将其强塞入车的企图，并试图逃跑，当时两人在马路上扭打。

pages.en:
1/3

The puller Kiang Ling Fah then raised an alarm by
shouting "Kidnappers". This caused the member of the
gang who was struggling with the complainant to loosen
his hold and run back to the car and step inside the
vehicle. The complainant meantime kept on running to-
wards the intersection of Moumein Road and Avenue Foch,
where S.P.C. 634 was on traffic duty. S.P.C. 634 heard
the alarm raised by the ricksha coolie and seeing the
complainant running towards him, mistook him for one of
the kidnappers. By the time the ricksha coolie came on
the scene and S.P.C. 634 found out his mistake, the kid-
nappers' car had passed them, being driven south on Moul-
mein Road and then east on Avenue Foch. The S.P.C. then
brought the parties concerned to the station to report
the case. Neither the complainant nor his puller were
able to give the correct licence number of the car in-
volved, and could only state that it was an old closed
dark painted hire car. Lengthy enquiries were made on
Moulmein Road near the Kwang Hwa Middle School but no
persons were located who could give the Police any fur-
ther information bearing on the case. Message was cir-
culated in order to make enquiries at all garages whether
any of their cars had been sent to Moulmein Road near
Avenue Foch early this a.m.

At the time when the attempted kidnapping took place.
pages.zh:
1/3

车夫江林發随即高喊“绑匪”以示警报。这导致正在与投诉人扭打的团伙成员松手，跑回汽车并进入车内。与此同时，投诉人继续向莫利爱路与福煦路的交叉口跑去，警员634号当时正在该处执行交通勤务。警员634号听到黄包车夫的呼救声，看到投诉人向他跑来，误以为他是绑匪之一。待黄包车夫赶到现场，警员634号发现弄错时，绑匪的汽车已经驶过他们身边，沿莫利爱路向南行驶，随后转入福煦路向东行驶。随后，该警员将相关人员带回巡捕房报案。投诉人及其车夫均无法提供涉案汽车的正确车牌号码，仅能说明那是一辆旧的、深色的封闭出租汽车。警方在光華中学附近的莫利爱路上进行了长时间调查，但未找到能提供进一步案情信息的人员。已发出通函，向所有车行查询，今晨是否有车辆被派往福煦路附近的莫利爱路。

在发生绑架未遂事件时。

pages.en:
1/4

complainant states that he did not see any firearms and
besides the person who stopped his ricksha, complainant
formed the impression that two or more members of the
gang were waiting in the car. This is corroborated by
the complainant's ricksha coolie. Complainant has not
been the recipient of any threatening letters and no
telephone calls have been received at his home that would
indicate that an attempt was on foot to kidnap him. On
account of the half hearted manner in which the offence
was attempted, also the absence of firearms, it is thought
that the kidnapping was attempted for political reasons
bearing on the bank where the complainant is employed.

投诉人称，他未看到任何枪支，除了拦住他黄包车的那个人外，投诉人印象中还有两名或更多团伙成员在车内等候。投诉人的黄包车夫证实了这一点。投诉人未曾收到任何恐吓信，其家中也未接到表明有人策划绑架他的电话。鉴于作案手法犹豫不决，且未使用枪支，推测此次绑架企图是出于与其受雇银行有关的政治原因。

August 22, 194.
Morning Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News, National Herald, Sin Wan Pao,
Shun Pao :-

ATTEMPTED KIDNAPPING AT THE CORNER OF MOULMEIN ROAD AND
AVENUE FOCH

Kung Pan-hsi (孔繁熙) alias Sung-sun (宋森),
aged 43, residing in House No. 6, Lane 75, Moulmein Road, has
been Chief of the Paying Department of the China State Bank
on Avenue Joffre for many years.
At about 8.45 a.m. yesterday, Kung left his home
for the bank in his private ricsha. When the ricsha reached
the vicinity of the Foh Kee Lumber Hong (復記木行) at the
corner of Moulmein Road and Avenue Foch, a man suddenly jumped
out from the roadside, seized the shafts of the ricsha and
attempted to drag Kung down from the ricsha into a waiting
motor car. Kung struggled and broke away, shouting loudly
for help, in which he was joined by the ricsha puller. Knowing
that there was a policeman on post duty on Avenue Foch, the
desperado immediately jumped into the waiting motor car and
drove away.
FILE
Observing that the motor car had left, the ricsha
puller reported the occurrence to a policeman on duty in the
vicinity who gave chase but did not succeed in catching up
with the motor car.
It is learned that a suspect was arrested in the
vicinity and was taken to the Police Station together with
Kung Pan-hsi. Officers were detailed to make an investigation
at the scene of the affair. The licence number of the motor
car is unknown.

194.年8月22日。
晨间译文。

《中美日报》、《国民新闻》、《新晚报》、
《申报》：

莫利爱路与福煦路转角发生绑架未遂案

孔繁熙 (Kung Pan-hsi)，别名宋森 (Sung-sun)，
43岁，居住于莫利爱路75弄6号，多年来一直担任霞飞路中国银行付款部主任。
昨日上午8时45分左右，孔某乘私人黄包车离家前往银行。当黄包车到达莫利爱路与福煦路转角处的復記木行附近时，一名男子突然从路边跳出，抓住黄包车车杠，试图将孔某从车上拖下并塞进一辆等候的汽车中。孔某挣扎脱身，大声呼救，黄包车夫也一同呼救。歹徒知悉福煦路上有警察站岗，立即跳进等候的汽车驾车逃离。
归档
见汽车离去，黄包车夫向附近执勤的一名警察报告了此事，该警察虽进行追赶，但未能追上汽车。
据悉，一名嫌疑人在附近被捕，并与孔繁熙一同被带往巡捕房。已指派警官前往事发地点进行调查。涉案汽车的车牌号码不详。
